opening_line: Saw the JDUFF Construction site, "relationships first and buildings second" is a strong idea to build a site around. I've designed a few construction sites myself.
Saw the Hoopfest identity, the wordmark and illustrations fit the world's largest 3-on-3 tournament well.
Saw the Barrett Hospital and Sheridan Memorial Hospital work. I've designed a few healthcare sites myself.
Looks like most of your clients are ranchers, butchers and meat processors. I've designed a few farm sites myself.
Saw the Hollywood Theatre redesign, keeping people on the branded site until the final checkout step is a smart way around Agile Ticketing.
Saw the Boss Gal Beauty Bar site, getting a med spa's personality across is harder than it looks. I've designed a few clinic sites myself.
Saw the Woody's Wing House work, carrying one brand guide from the logo all the way through the website. I've designed a few restaurant sites myself.
Saw KBE Design Build and Williams Architects in your portfolio. I've designed a few construction sites myself.
Looks like most of your clients are contractors and home service companies. I've designed a few construction and HVAC sites myself.
Saw the Sharp Litigation site, clean and simple is exactly what a litigation firm needs. I've designed a few law firm sites myself.
Saw the Runde & Partners rebrand, logo through website for a Bay Area property valuation firm. I've designed a few real estate sites myself.
Saw the Clark Health redesign, making seven primary care clinics easy to find and book is real patient-first work. I've designed a few clinic sites myself.
Saw the Miamica makeover, moving them off Magento onto a custom WooCommerce build with a cleaner checkout.
